Standalone verifier completes 894 finite assertions; infinity is proved analytically.

value.rationale: The previously available feasibility criterion does not identify how responsibility for an observed maximum can be distributed among coordinates. This supplies sharp, complete and constructive region of all such winner frequencies for arbitrary fixed margins, including a precise nontrivial two-variable unique-winner range [1/4,3/4] despite exactly the same prescribed maximum law. Such event attribution is a natural mathematical observable in dependence, competing risks, and extreme-value attribution. This is a structural classification rather than an arbitrary numerical slice.
